description: This file is a test script for Git stash configuration, testing different settings of stash.showStat and stash.showPatch options, and their impact on git stash show output.

methods.name: test_stat_and_patch
methods.description: Main test function that configures stash.showStat and stash.showPatch options, creates a diff, stashes changes, and verifies the output of 'git stash show' against expectations.
